About the method
- `reg_rf`: Random Forest for regression.
- Main parameters: `mtry` and `ntree`.

Didactic goal: keep the same regression line of experiment and change only the learner to a tree ensemble.

Environment setup.
```{r}
source(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cefet-rj-dal/daltoolbox/main/examples/seed.R"))
# install.packages("daltoolbox")

library(daltoolbox)
```

Load data and inspect.
```{r}
data(Diabetes)
head(Diabetes)
```

Target `target` and reproducible train/test split.
```{r}
set_example_seed()
sr <- train_test(sample_random(), Diabetes)
diabetes_train <- sr$train
diabetes_test <- sr$test
```

Model configuration and fitting.
```{r}
model <- reg_rf("target", mtry = 7, ntree = 30)
set_example_seed()
model <- fit(model, diabetes_train)
```

Training evaluation.
```{r}
train_prediction <- predict(model, diabetes_train)
train_eval <- evaluate(model, diabetes_train[, "target"], train_prediction)
train_eval$metrics
```

Test evaluation.
```{r}
test_prediction <- predict(model, diabetes_test)
test_eval <- evaluate(model, diabetes_test[, "target"], test_prediction)
test_eval$metrics
```

References
- Breiman, L. (2001). Random Forests.
